correctness.rationale: Using raw sorted angle triples (1/2,x,y+1/2) for L and (1/2,y,x+1/2) for R, finite case sorting gives invariant L chamber F after at most two steps and invariant R chamber G after at most one. Within F the unchanged middle angle and sum of extremes give a_{n+1}=S−a_n/2; within G the same recurrence holds on the two other leading angles. Thus the closed forms converge to the stated individual fixed points with alternating exact factor 1/2 except at already-fixed inputs. The four-piece and two-piece rational projections follow by substitution of entry cases, agree across chamber walls, and are idempotent/retractions. I independently recomputed sorted child maps and verified entry, projection intertwining and asymptotics on 654 exact rational shapes with varied denominators; nonfixed chamber witnesses show sharpness. The proof is for eventual pure itineraries, not arbitrary mixed infinite paths.
